label: GPT-6.1 Terra
output:
Thanks for asking, Deirdre, and for giving me a chance to comment before SMT rather than just announcing it. I do understand the numbers and that Bronwyn needs the help with 24 little ones, so I’m not going to fight the move.

I won’t pretend I’m not sad about it though. Noma has been with me in the Seahorses for three years, since my first year of teaching, and she really helped me find my feet. We’ve built a lovely routine together, and the children adore her. They ask for “Noma’s song” every day at morning ring!

My main concern is the handover. The first weeks of Grade R are always the hardest, with new little ones crying at the gate and everyone finding their feet. Having a new assistant and a whole new group at the same time feels like a lot to manage without some time to settle Charlene in. Two of the children, Luthando and Mia, also already know Noma from aftercare, so seeing her at the start would be a comfort.

Could Charlene possibly come in for a day or two during the last week of term, 1–4 December, to meet Noma and see how our routine works? I know she officially starts on 11 January, so I’m not sure if that can be arranged, but it would make such a difference.

And could Noma perhaps pop in for morning ring during the first week back from 14 January, even if it’s just for 15 minutes? It would give the children a familiar face and give Charlene a chance to learn the songs and routine. I know Grade 00 will need her too, so I’d be grateful for whatever is possible.

Thanks again for asking, Deirdre. I’d really appreciate it if you could put those two handover requests to SMT.
